note.summary:
2.3 Celebrity culture
Key focus
- famous people, media influence, role models, fame and achievements.

Core language
- Useful structures: मेरे विचार में; मुझे ... पसंद है क्योंकि; पिछले साल; अगली बार; आम तौर पर; मुझे ... चाहिए।
- Support opinions with evidence; use relative clauses and comparatives without confusing who/what is being discussed.

Exam tips
- For comprehension, locate the exact word or phrase that proves each answer.
- In translation, preserve tense, negatives, quantities and relationships between people.
- In writing, add opinions and reasons, vary time frames, and check verb and adjective agreement.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.
questions.modelAnswer: मेरी पसंदीदा गायिका अपने गाने खुद लिखती है और पियानो भी बजाती है।
questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

My favourite singer writes her own songs and also plays the piano.

Translate into Hindi:

Translate into Hindi:

questions.modelAnswer: मुझे ऐसे प्रसिद्ध लोग पसंद हैं जो अपनी गलतियों के बारे में सच बोलते हैं।
questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

I prefer famous people who speak honestly about their mistakes.

questions.examTip: Cover every bullet, use past and future forms where relevant, and justify opinions with क्योंकि.
questions.modelAnswer:
मेरी पसंदीदा गायिका अपने गाने खुद लिखती है और पियानो भी बजाती है। इस खिलाड़ी ने चोट के बावजूद दौड़ जीत ली। बहुत-से युवा सोशल मीडिया पर प्रसिद्ध लोगों की शैली की नकल करते हैं। मेरे विचार में यह महत्वपूर्ण है और भविष्य में मैं एक नया अनुभव लेना चाहूँगा।

(English translation: My favourite singer writes her own songs and also plays the piano. This athlete won the race despite an injury. Many young people copy the style of famous people on social media. In my opinion it is important, and in the future I would like to have a new experience.)
